articleBodyHtml:
Upcoming Announcements and Streams

The speaker is planning to make a 'little medium announcement' on Sunday. This is mentioned in multiple segments, and the speaker also refers to a stream that will include announcements, possibly involving karaoke or other activities.

The stream is described as a 'Small Workspace stream' and will be members-only. It is scheduled for the same time as the current day but a little later, and the speaker is excited about it.
